hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; [ -x node_modules/.bin/prettier ] || exit 0; case "$f" in */node_modules/*|*/dist/*|*/docs/*|*/songs/*|*/.claude/*) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in *.ts|*.js) node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; *.css|*.html|*.json) node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; case "$f" in */src/*.ts|*/scripts/*.ts) n=$(wc -l < "$f"); if [ "$n" -gt 300 ]; then echo "$f is now $n lines, over the 300-line budget in CLAUDE.md section 3. Split it along the module map, or state explicitly why it should stay whole." >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; exit 0
c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$c" in *vitest*|*'npm test'*|*'npm run test'*) mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude" && : > "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/.tests-green";; esac; exit 0

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; M=.claude/.tests-green; [ -f "$M" ] || exit 0; rm -f "$M"; n() { find "$@" -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.css' -o -name '*.html' -o -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.md' -o -name '*.json' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -printf '%T@\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -1; }; code=$(n src scripts content index.html package.json); docs=$(n README.md CLAUDE.md); [ -n "$code" ] && [ -n "$docs" ] || exit 0; awk -v c="$code" -v d="$docs" 'BEGIN{exit !(c>d)}' || exit 0; echo "Tests are green and code is newer than the docs. Run the doc-writer subagent before calling this step done: it re-syncs README.md, the CLAUDE.md module map (section 3) and the new-song template against section 2.1. If nothing needs changing, say so explicitly." >&2; exit 2
